_comment: Thresholds for autopilot/auto_mode.py auto_select_mode(). Edit values here, no code changes needed.
_design: AGGRESSIVE-by-default with a downgrade-only circuit breaker. Past the new-user window, mode starts at AGGRESSIVE; trailing metrics can only pull it DOWN, never up on their own — recovery requires hysteresis_confirmations consecutive clean reads.
_hysteresis_comment: Recovery to a MORE aggressive mode requires this many consecutive clean (no-breach) evaluations before taking effect. Downgrades always apply immediately.
_regime_gate_comment: If true, AGGRESSIVE is capped to BALANCED whenever Nifty 50 is below its 50-day EMA (see ingestion.nse_constituents.get_market_regime), regardless of the account's own trailing metrics.
